name: Air
notes: At 20 °C and 1 atm. Its density gives every object its drag and buoyancy.

name: Smoke
notes: Hot air (~120 °C) carrying soot: lighter than air, so it rises.

notes: A rigid blob until there's a fluid solver.

name: Honey
